data.message: Individual opt-in, not an all-or-nothing deal: I commit to 18 tons and invite each of the other 24 to choose 18. Versus 10, that's $8,000 extra now if fulfilled. If k choose 18 and all others 10, catch=250+8k, remainder=250-8k; next stock is 500 (75%) or 500-16k (25%). Recovery isn't guaranteed; this may not maximize long-run income. Intentions aren't enforceable; other catches need recalculation. Each person: state your exact intended catch and whether it depends on others.

I propose 10 tons each this month. Total catch would be 250, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That supports $10,000 per person every month without collapse risk if everyone follows it. I intend to request 10 and invite all 25 fishers to adopt this repeatable limit.

I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month: 25 × 10 = 250 tons caught, leaving 250, so stock returns to 500 under either replenishment outcome. That earns each of us $10,000 monthly indefinitely if maintained. I intend to request 10 if this plan gains broad support. Please state your intended cap; catches afterward will show whether we followed through.
